summary: Keeps Curse of Recklessness (505 armor) on the boss for the raid instead of a druid's Faerie Fire. In Forever, curses and banes use separate slots, so it keeps its bane.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadow Bolt at -2.5s (lands just after the pull)
Racials on cooldown, except Troll Berserking
Life Tap below 5% mana or when the filler costs more than the mana left

Curse of Recklessness right after the opener, recast before it drops (2 min). It takes 505 armor in the minor armor slot, so the raid's Faerie Fire and Curse of Recklessness are off. The raid's Curse of the Elements stays on
Bane of Doom with more than 60s left, so it lands before the end
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when it is down (more than 9s left)
Immolate when it is down or ends within its cast time, with more than 15s left
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
Troll Berserking right before a Shadow Bolt, so the haste goes on cast spells, not instants
Siphon Life when it is down
Wrack while Corruption and the bane are both up
Shadow Bolt as the filler (instant on Nightfall procs)
caveats: Wrack's 86 a second and 0.286 coefficient are the development notes' values; client 1.60.1.70753 still has 36 and 0.143 (notes-only, standards 37).

The duty costs 14.7 DPS at 180s against the same build without it (1003.4 against 1018.1, 20,000 iterations, seed 1). The curse only takes armor, which helps only a demon's melee, so the warlock pays its GCDs and mana for the raid.
Bane of Doom's coefficient is 4.0 (Era has 1.0). At 2.0, Shadow Bolt builds would lose about 4%. At 1.0, about 6%.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Shadow Bolt stops at rank IX, Immolate at VII and Corruption at VI. The books would add 7 to 13 DPS.
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is active. The 5-piece added about 8 to 13 DPS on an older gear set.
Soul shards and Life Tap's health cost aren't tracked.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warlock__affliction except -apl level60_affliction_duty_recklessness, then raid.debuffs.curseOfRecklessness and faerieFire removed (they share the minor armor slot, standards 20). Made as a hand edit of the base request, which is the same. Demon Armor; no demon out, the Imp sacrificed, imbue Spellstone (the Wrack build since round 70753). mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 30 (standards 33 since 2026-11-02, the longest range its spells reach; 25 from 2026-11-01, 5 before) and channelClipDelayMs 50, as the UI preset does. A raid sim variant (docs/raid_sim.md, M1b), in the DPS report since 2026-10-30. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Undead since round 70753, following its base (the Wrack build with the Imp sacrificed, where the Orc's Command does nothing).
